content.short: Grasshopper Bank is a chartered US digital business bank for startups, SMEs, fintechs and the innovation economy.
content.description: Grasshopper Bank is a US digital-first commercial bank built for startups, small and medium businesses and the innovation economy. As a chartered, FDIC-member bank, it offers business checking with yield, corporate and virtual cards, SBA and commercial lending, venture and fund banking, and embedded banking services for fintech partners. Grasshopper targets founders and growing companies that want modern online banking backed by a real bank rather than a fintech layered on a partner bank. Its mix of business accounts, cards and lending, plus API-based embedded finance, keeps payments and financial operations central to how startups and SMEs manage money.
